name: @joeybuilt/koforje-bridge
description: Proxies tool calls to Koforje's HTTP API for workspace, file search, agent run, and deploy operations.
author: Joeybuilt LLC

capabilitiesRationale.storage:read: Reads the Koforje connection credentials (koforje_user_id) to authenticate API calls.

tools.name: koforje.workspace.get
tools.description: Fetch details of a single Koforje workspace.

tools.name: koforje.workspace.create
tools.description: Create a new Koforje workspace, optionally cloning a Git repo.

tools.name: koforje.workspace.delete
tools.description: Delete a Koforje workspace by ID.

tools.name: koforje.file.search
tools.description: Text or semantic search across files in a Koforje workspace.

tools.name: koforje.agent.run
tools.description: Trigger an agent run inside a Koforje workspace.

tools.name: koforje.agent.runs.list
tools.description: List recent agent runs for a workspace.

tools.name: koforje.deploy.create
tools.description: Trigger a deploy of a Koforje workspace.

tools.name: koforje.deploy.list
tools.description: List recent deploys for a workspace.
